stories.stat_label: years since the zoo's last eggs
stories.headline: Adelaide Zoo's cassowaries laid their 1st eggs in 34 years
stories.summary: Martina, 10, and Jeffrey, 13, were paired for the 1st time and soon 2 bright green eggs appeared. Keepers don't know yet if they're fertile, but they're watching closely.
stories.why: The vivid green shell is camouflage, hiding the eggs from predators in the forest.

stories.headline: Blood cells from an 80-year-old were reset to under 20
stories.summary: Scientists turned an 80-year-old's blood cells into brain stem cells whose molecular age read under 20. The change happened slowly enough to track for over 100 days.
stories.why: It's a lab model, not a treatment, but it lets scientists study how cells get younger.

stories.stat_label: train delay caused by a solar storm
stories.headline: A 178-year-old solar storm mystery was solved by a typo
stories.summary: An 1871 report said a solar storm delayed an Exeter train by 16 minutes in 1841. But that rail line only opened in 1846. Old records show it really happened in 1848.
stories.why: It's still one of the 1st times space weather is known to have disrupted technology.

stories.stat_label: when he started building his boat
stories.headline: Strangers are helping an 86-year-old finish his 62-foot boat
stories.summary: Dale has welded a steel boat in his yard since 1987, dreaming of sailing to Alaska. 3 visitors from England started a fundraiser, and 1,500+ people gave over $41,000 in days.
stories.why: The money will help finish the boat and move it down a steep hill to the water.

fun_fact: Dale's backyard boat already has 4 staterooms and is about 75% finished.
